title: Sepsis Early Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Escalate immediately when infection plus organ dysfunction or shock is suspected.
Obtain cultures quickly when feasible and start appropriate empiric antimicrobials without avoidable delay.
Assess lactate, perfusion, and fluid responsiveness early and reassess after initial resuscitation.

title: Acute Stroke Initial Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Treat suspected stroke as a time-critical emergency and document last-known-well time immediately.
Obtain urgent brain imaging before determining reperfusion eligibility.
Screen for hypoglycemia and other stroke mimics while keeping imaging and escalation moving.

medication_warnings.message: Confirm anticoagulant exposure and timing before considering reperfusion therapy.

title: Diabetic Ketoacidosis Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Start structured fluid resuscitation, insulin therapy, and electrolyte monitoring promptly when DKA is confirmed or strongly suspected.
Review potassium before insulin escalation and replace aggressively when low or falling.
Search for precipitating infection, omission of insulin, or other acute triggers while treatment is underway.

contraindications.label: hypokalemia
contraindications.reason: Severe hypokalemia must be corrected before insulin intensification.

title: Hypertensive Emergency Initial Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Differentiate hypertensive emergency from severe asymptomatic hypertension by looking for acute end-organ injury.
Lower blood pressure in a controlled monitored setting when emergency features are present rather than pursuing rapid unsupervised correction.
Tailor agent selection to the affected organ system and pregnancy status.

contraindications.label: pregnancy
contraindications.reason: Use pregnancy-appropriate antihypertensives and evaluate urgently for pre-eclampsia-related disease.
